intent.raw_query: Swiss Alps ski holiday family, $7000, 7 days, February

experiences.name: Zermatt Ski Safari
experiences.description: Explore the legendary slopes of Zermatt with access to over 360km of groomed pistes beneath the iconic Matterhorn. Take the Gornergrat cogwheel railway to reach high-altitude runs and enjoy varied terrain suitable for all skill levels, with breathtaking panoramic views of 29 peaks over 4000m.

experiences.name: Verbier Freeride Experience
experiences.description: Join a guided off-piste freeride session in Verbier, one of the world's top freeride destinations. A certified mountain guide leads you through untracked powder fields and challenging couloirs in the Mont Fort area, offering an adrenaline-packed adventure for intermediate to advanced skiers.

experiences.name: Jungfraujoch Top of Europe Tour
experiences.description: Ride the cogwheel train to Jungfraujoch at 3,454m, the highest railway station in Europe. Explore the Ice Palace carved inside the glacier, walk on the Aletsch Glacier, and enjoy stunning views of the surrounding Alpine peaks. A once-in-a-lifetime mountain experience combining culture and nature.

experiences.name: Swiss Alpine Fondue Evening
experiences.description: Warm up after a day on the slopes with a traditional Swiss cheese fondue dinner at a cozy mountain chalet restaurant in Grindelwald. Enjoy locally sourced Gruyère and Emmental cheeses paired with Swiss wines and regional bread, immersing yourself in authentic Alpine culinary culture.

experiences.name: Davos Cross-Country Skiing & Nordic Trail
experiences.description: Glide through 100km of perfectly groomed Nordic trails around Davos, the highest city in Europe. This full-day cross-country skiing experience takes you through pristine snow-covered forests and frozen lakes, with optional instruction from a local Nordic coach for beginners and intermediates.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Swiss Alps, Switzerland
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: N/A - Flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A - In transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Zurich or Milan Malpensa airport at 22:30. Take a pre-booked budget train or bus transfer toward Poschiavo. The Bernina Express or regional rail via Tirano connects to Poschiavo. Check in to B&B Berninapass Poschiavo Panorama, settle in, and rest after the long journey.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or airport snack
meals.lunch: Airport or transit food court — budget around CHF 10-15
meals.dinner: Grab a quick sandwich or snack from a train station kiosk or convenience store en route — budget CHF 8-12

day_by_day.notes: Pre-book your train ticket in advance via SBB (Swiss Federal Railways) app for the best budget fares. The Poschiavo valley is in the Graubünden canton. If arriving very late, confirm check-in arrangements with the B&B host ahead of time. Pack light layers as temperatures in Poschiavo in February average -2°C to 4°C.

day_by_day.morning: After a well-deserved rest, enjoy a hearty B&B breakfast included with your stay. Then take a short walk through the charming historic village of Poschiavo — explore the Piazza Comunale, the Spanish Quarter (Quartiere Spagnolo) with its colorful Italianate houses, and the Reformed Church. This is a free and scenic orientation walk.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the nearby Lago di Poschiavo (Lake Poschiavo), a stunning frozen or partially frozen alpine lake in winter. Walk along the lakeside path for free panoramic mountain views. Alternatively, rent cross-country ski equipment from a local rental shop in Poschiavo (approx. CHF 20-30/day) and explore the flat lakeside trails — perfect for beginners and budget-friendly.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the village center. Stroll the illuminated streets of Poschiavo at dusk for a magical alpine atmosphere. Relax at the B&B and plan the week ahead.

meals.breakfast: Included at B&B Berninapass Poschiavo Panorama
meals.lunch: Pizzeria or local café in Poschiavo village — try a simple pasta or pizza for CHF 12-18. Try Ristorante Croce Federale for affordable local fare.
meals.dinner: Self-catering option: pick up groceries from the local Coop or Migros supermarket in Poschiavo and cook a simple meal — budget CHF 10-15 per person

day_by_day.notes: Poschiavo is a UNESCO World Heritage village. The Bernina railway line running through it is also a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Cross-country ski rentals are available at local sports shops. Confirm lake conditions before walking on ice.

day_by_day.morning: Take the iconic Bernina Express train (or regional Rhaetian Railway train for a cheaper fare — approx. CHF 15-20 one way) from Poschiavo up to Ospizio Bernina or Diavolezza station. The train ride itself through the snow-covered Bernina Pass is breathtaking and one of the world's most scenic rail journeys.
day_by_day.afternoon: At Diavolezza (2,978m), enjoy world-class skiing and snowboarding. A day ski pass at Diavolezza costs approximately CHF 55-65. Rent ski equipment on-site for around CHF 35-45. The resort offers runs for all levels with stunning views of the Bernina massif and Morteratsch Glacier. Budget skiers can focus on a half-day pass (CHF 35-45) to save money.
day_by_day.evening: Return by train to Poschiavo in the late afternoon. Warm up with a hot chocolate or Glühwein (mulled wine) at a local café — budget CHF 4-6. Early dinner and rest to recover from a full day of skiing.

meals.breakfast: Included at B&B
meals.lunch: Pack a homemade sandwich and thermos of hot tea/coffee from the B&B to eat on the mountain — saves CHF 20-30 vs. mountain restaurant prices
meals.dinner: Osteria Poschiavina or a local trattoria in Poschiavo — hearty Graubünden dishes like Pizzoccheri (buckwheat pasta) or Maluns for CHF 15-22

day_by_day.notes: Book Diavolezza ski passes online in advance for potential discounts. The Rhaetian Railway regional train is significantly cheaper than the tourist Bernina Express — check SBB.ch for timetables. Dress in warm waterproof layers. Helmet rental is recommended (CHF 8-10 extra).

day_by_day.morning: Rest morning — sleep in and enjoy a leisurely B&B breakfast. Then take a free snowshoe walk (or rent snowshoes for CHF 15-20) along the Bernina Pass area trails. The route from Poschiavo toward Alp Grüm offers stunning glacier and mountain panoramas with minimal cost.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Alp Grüm viewpoint — accessible by the Rhaetian Railway (short hop, approx. CHF 8-12). This dramatic vantage point overlooks the Palü Glacier and the Italian valley below. Walk the snow-covered paths around the area. Photography enthusiasts will love the sweeping alpine vistas.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Poschiavo. Visit the local Museo di Poschiavo (small entry fee approx. CHF 5) to learn about the valley's history, culture, and the famous Bernina railway. Spend a quiet evening at the B&B.

meals.breakfast: Included at B&B
meals.lunch: Café at Alp Grüm station — simple soup and bread for CHF 10-15, or bring packed lunch
meals.dinner: Self-catering at B&B using supermarket groceries — cook a simple pasta or risotto, budget CHF 8-12

day_by_day.notes: Alp Grüm is only accessible by train in winter — no road access. The Rhaetian Railway runs regularly from Poschiavo. Snowshoe rental is available at sports shops in the village. This is a great recovery day after intense skiing.

day_by_day.morning: Take an early regional train to St. Moritz (approx. 1 hour, CHF 20-25 one way with Swiss Travel Pass discount if applicable). Explore the famous resort town on foot — window shop on the Via Serlas, admire the frozen St. Moritz Lake, and soak in the glamorous atmosphere for free.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to Corviglia ski area above St. Moritz. A day pass costs CHF 72-80, but a half-day afternoon pass (from 12:30) costs approximately CHF 55-60 — a better budget option. Alternatively, enjoy free sledding on designated public slopes near the lake, or watch the famous horse racing on the frozen lake (if scheduled during your visit — check events at stmoritz.com).
day_by_day.evening: Return to Poschiavo by regional train. St. Moritz has expensive dining, so eat dinner back in Poschiavo. Treat yourself to a slightly nicer dinner to celebrate the midpoint of the trip.

meals.breakfast: Included at B&B — eat well before the day trip
meals.lunch: Bring packed lunch from B&B to eat in St. Moritz — avoid the expensive resort restaurants
meals.dinner: Ristorante Albrici in Poschiavo — a historic local restaurant with traditional Graubünden cuisine, mains CHF 18-28

day_by_day.notes: St. Moritz is one of the world's most expensive ski resorts, but visiting for the atmosphere and a half-day ski pass makes it budget-feasible. Check the Swiss Travel Pass — it may cover regional train fares and offer ski pass discounts. The frozen lake events (polo, horse racing, cricket on ice) are free to watch from the lakeside.

day_by_day.morning: Full day back at Diavolezza or explore the Livigno area (just across the Italian border, accessible by PostBus from Poschiavo — approx. CHF 10-15 each way). Livigno is a duty-free Italian ski resort with significantly cheaper ski passes (approx. €35-45/day) and equipment rentals than Swiss resorts — a great budget skiing option.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue skiing or snowboarding at Livigno. The resort has 115km of pistes across Mottolino and Carosello 3000 areas. Beginners can take affordable group ski lessons (approx. €25-35 for 2 hours). The duty-free status also means cheaper après-ski drinks and snacks.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Poschiavo by PostBus. Enjoy a final relaxed evening in the village. Take a night walk through the illuminated historic center of Poschiavo.

meals.breakfast: Included at B&B
meals.lunch: Mountain restaurant in Livigno — Italian prices are much lower, pizza or pasta for €10-14
meals.dinner: Local Poschiavo restaurant or self-catering — try Capuns (Swiss chard rolls with spätzle) if available, a traditional Graubünden dish

day_by_day.notes: Check PostBus schedules from Poschiavo to Livigno at postauto.ch — services may be limited in winter. Bring your passport as you cross into Italy. Livigno's duty-free status means cheaper ski gear, snacks, and fuel. Saturday may be busier on the slopes — arrive early.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — enjoy a last B&B breakfast and pack up. Take a short farewell walk through Poschiavo village and along the lake. Visit the local Sunday market if operating, or browse any small artisan shops for affordable Swiss souvenirs (local honey, Bündner Nusstorte nut tart, or dried meats).
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight, take the Rhaetian Railway or Bernina Express toward Tirano (Italy) or back north toward Chur and Zurich. The Bernina Express to Tirano (approx. CHF 15-20 regional fare) connects to Italian rail toward Milan Malpensa airport. Alternatively, travel north via Chur to Zurich airport.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Switzerland. Reflect on an incredible budget week in the Swiss Alps — world-class skiing, stunning mountain scenery, and authentic alpine culture at a fraction of typical Swiss travel costs.

meals.breakfast: Included at B&B — final hearty alpine breakfast
meals.lunch: Train station or airport food — budget CHF 10-15, or use remaining groceries for a packed lunch
meals.dinner: Airport dining or on the flight home

day_by_day.notes: Check out time at B&B is typically 10:00-11:00 — confirm with host. Store luggage at the B&B if needed while doing a final morning walk. Book return train tickets in advance via SBB.ch. The Bernina Express to Tirano is a spectacular final journey through the Alps. Total estimated budget for the week (excluding flights): CHF 600-850 per person, including accommodation, ski passes (3 days), transport, and meals.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Late arrival day
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – Late arrival day
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Zurich Airport on flight UA at 22:30. Clear customs, collect luggage, and arrange pre-booked transfer or take the train toward Poschiavo. Check in to B&B Berninapass Poschiavo Panorama upon arrival. Settle into your room and rest.

meals.breakfast: N/A – In-flight or airport dining
meals.lunch: N/A – In-flight meal
meals.dinner: Light snack from airport or train station convenience store (Migros To Go or SBB station kiosk) – CHF 10–15

day_by_day.notes: The journey from Zurich Airport to Poschiavo takes approximately 3.5–4 hours by train (via Chur and the Bernina Express route). Pre-book your transfer or train ticket in advance. Given the late arrival, no activities are scheduled for Day 1. Pack light snacks for the journey.

day_by_day.morning: After a well-deserved rest, enjoy breakfast at the B&B and take in the stunning panoramic views of the Poschiavo valley. Head to the nearby Livigno ski area (approx. 45 min drive across the Italian border – bring passport), a tax-free resort with excellent beginner-to-intermediate slopes. Rent ski equipment at the resort if needed and purchase a half-day or full-day lift pass. Spend the morning exploring the lower groomed pistes.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue skiing on Livigno's 115km of slopes. Try the Carosello 3000 sector for wider, sunnier runs with panoramic Alpine views. Take a mid-afternoon break at a mountain refuge for a warm drink and enjoy the scenery before heading back down.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Poschiavo by early evening. Freshen up at the B&B and stroll through the charming historic village center of Poschiavo, a UNESCO-listed Spanish quarter with colorful Italianate architecture.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at B&B Berninapass Poschiavo Panorama – included with stay
meals.lunch: Mountain refuge lunch at Livigno – try local pasta or polenta with cheese – CHF 18–25
meals.dinner: Dinner at Ristorante Suisse in Poschiavo – traditional Graubünden cuisine including pizzoccheri (buckwheat pasta) and local wine – CHF 30–40 per person

day_by_day.notes: Livigno is technically in Italy so bring your passport. Lift passes cost approximately CHF 45–55 for a day. Equipment rental is around CHF 30–40. The tax-free status makes Livigno great for affordable gear and après-ski shopping.

day_by_day.morning: Board the iconic Bernina Express (or regional train) from Poschiavo toward St. Moritz (approx. 1 hour). From St. Moritz, connect to Zermatt for the Zermatt Ski Safari experience. Explore the legendary slopes of Zermatt with access to over 360km of groomed pistes beneath the iconic Matterhorn. Start with the Sunnegga Paradise sector for stunning morning light on the mountain.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Zermatt Ski Safari on the Rothorn and Gornergrat sectors. Intermediate and advanced skiers will love the long red and black runs with breathtaking views of 29 peaks over 4,000m. Take the Gornergrat cogwheel railway up for a panoramic lunch stop before skiing back down.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the vibrant Zermatt village atmosphere – the car-free village is magical in winter. Browse the boutiques along the main street before heading back toward Poschiavo via train. Alternatively, stay overnight in Zermatt if budget allows for a more relaxed return.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at B&B before departure
meals.lunch: Lunch at Riffelhaus 1853 restaurant near Gornergrat – mountain soup, rösti, or a burger – CHF 25–35
meals.dinner: Dinner at Restaurant Whymper-Stube in Zermatt before departure – fondue or raclette – CHF 35–45 per person, OR a simpler train station meal on the return journey – CHF 15–20

day_by_day.notes: Zermatt is approximately 3.5 hours from Poschiavo by train (via Chur or St. Moritz). Consider an early start (7:00–7:30 AM) to maximize ski time. A Zermatt day ski pass costs approximately CHF 85–95. Book the Zermatt Ski Safari experience in advance. The return journey will be long – plan to arrive back at the B&B by 22:00–23:00.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning after the big Zermatt day. Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the B&B. Take a gentle morning walk along the Poschiavo valley floor, following the flat riverside path through snow-dusted meadows. This is a perfect low-intensity activity to rest your ski legs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the Davos Cross-Country Skiing & Nordic Trail experience (approx. 2 hours by train via Chur). Glide through 100km of perfectly groomed Nordic trails around Davos, the highest city in Europe. Rent Nordic ski equipment at the Davos Sport rental shops near the train station. The Flüela and Dischma valley trails are particularly scenic and suitable for all levels.
day_by_day.evening: Explore Davos Platz town center before returning to Poschiavo. Visit the Kirchner Museum or simply enjoy a warm drink at a café. Take the evening train back to Poschiavo.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely breakfast at B&B Berninapass Poschiavo Panorama – included
meals.lunch: Packed lunch or snack from a Poschiavo bakery before departure – CHF 8–12
meals.dinner: Dinner at Restaurant Café Grischun in Davos – hearty Swiss mountain fare including Bündnerfleisch (air-dried beef) and barley soup – CHF 28–38 per person

day_by_day.notes: Nordic ski rental in Davos costs approximately CHF 20–30. A Nordic trail pass is around CHF 10–15. Davos is well connected by train from Poschiavo via Chur (approx. 2 hours). This is a great active recovery day that uses different muscle groups than alpine skiing.

day_by_day.morning: Depart early from Poschiavo for the Jungfraujoch Top of Europe Tour. Take the train via Chur and Interlaken to Grindelwald or Lauterbrunnen (approx. 3.5–4 hours). Board the cogwheel train to Jungfraujoch at 3,454m – the highest railway station in Europe. Explore the Ice Palace, Sphinx Observatory, and the vast Aletsch Glacier panorama.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Jungfraujoch – try snow tubing or a short snowshoe walk on the glacier plateau. Visit the Snow Fun Park for some light winter fun. Begin the descent back to Grindelwald or Wengen by mid-afternoon. Optionally, stop at Kleine Scheidegg for a scenic break and hot chocolate.
day_by_day.evening: Return journey toward Poschiavo. The trip back will take approximately 3.5–4 hours. Enjoy the scenic train views as the sun sets over the Alps. Arrive back at the B&B by 21:00–22:00.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at B&B before departure
meals.lunch: Lunch at the Crystal Restaurant at Jungfraujoch – self-service mountain restaurant with hot meals – CHF 25–35 (note: prices are elevated at altitude)
meals.dinner: Light dinner at a train station restaurant in Interlaken or Bern during the return journey – CHF 18–25, OR a simple meal at the B&B if the host offers evening meals

day_by_day.notes: Book Jungfraujoch train tickets well in advance – they sell out quickly, especially on weekends. The Good Morning Ticket (early departure) offers a discount of approximately CHF 20. Round-trip tickets cost approximately CHF 145–165 from Interlaken. Dress in very warm layers – temperatures at 3,454m can be -15°C or colder. Altitude sickness is possible; take it slow at the top.

day_by_day.morning: A more relaxed morning based near Poschiavo. After breakfast, head to the Diavolezza ski area (approx. 45 min by Bernina Express train from Poschiavo to Diavolezza station). Diavolezza offers spectacular glacier skiing with views of Piz Palü and Piz Bernina. Take the cable car up and enjoy the wide open glacier runs – a truly world-class ski experience close to your base.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue skiing at Diavolezza or try the famous Diavolezza glacier descent – a 10km off-piste route down to Morteratsch (guide recommended). Alternatively, take the Verbier Freeride Experience if you've pre-booked a guided off-piste freeride session – Verbier is accessible by train (approx. 3 hours) for those seeking a more adventurous afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Poschiavo for a special Swiss Alpine Fondue Evening. Book a table at a local mountain chalet or restaurant offering traditional Swiss cheese fondue. Warm up after a day on the slopes with moitié-moitié fondue (Gruyère and Vacherin), crusty bread, and local white wine.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at B&B Berninahaus Poschiavo Panorama – included
meals.lunch: Lunch at the Diavolezza mountain restaurant – rösti, soup, or pasta – CHF 20–30
meals.dinner: Swiss Alpine Fondue Evening at a local Poschiavo restaurant or chalet – fondue set menu with wine – CHF 40–55 per person

day_by_day.notes: Diavolezza lift pass costs approximately CHF 55–65 for a day. The Bernina Express/regional train stops directly at Diavolezza station – very convenient from Poschiavo. Saturday can be busier on the slopes, so arrive early. The fondue dinner is a highlight – book ahead as good restaurants fill up on weekends.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in the Swiss Alps. Enjoy a leisurely last breakfast at the B&B and soak in the panoramic mountain views one last time. Take a short snowshoe walk or gentle hike near Poschiavo village – the area around Lago di Poschiavo (the lake) offers beautiful flat winter walking paths with stunning reflections of the surrounding peaks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack up and check out of the B&B. Take the scenic Bernina Express train northward – one of the world's most beautiful train journeys, crossing UNESCO-listed viaducts and glacial landscapes. Travel toward Chur or Zurich for your onward journey. If time permits before departure, explore Chur's charming old town (Switzerland's oldest city) for a final Swiss experience.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Zurich or your chosen departure point. Reflect on an incredible week of skiing, mountain exploration, and Swiss Alpine culture.

meals.breakfast: Final breakfast at B&B Berninapass Poschiavo Panorama – included
meals.lunch: Lunch in Chur old town – try a local bakery or restaurant for Bündner Nusstorte (walnut tart) and a warm meal – CHF 18–28
meals.dinner: Airport dining at Zurich Airport or in-flight meal – CHF 20–35 if dining at the airport

day_by_day.notes: Check out time at most Swiss B&Bs is 10:00–11:00 AM. The Bernina Express is a panoramic train – book a window seat in advance for the best views. The journey from Poschiavo to Chur takes approximately 2.5 hours. From Chur, Zurich Airport is about 1.5 hours by train. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for check-in and security at Zurich Airport.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival. Flight UA lands at 22:30. Transfer from airport to B&B Berninapass Poschiavo Panorama via private luxury transfer (pre-arranged). Check-in, unwind, and settle into your panoramic Alpine retreat.
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — travel day.
day_by_day.evening: Late-night arrival at 22:30. Light welcome amenities at the B&B — enjoy a glass of local Valposchiavo wine and a charcuterie board prepared by the host. Rest and prepare for the week ahead.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable (travel day)
meals.lunch: Not applicable (in transit)
meals.dinner: Light in-room welcome board arranged by the B&B — local cured meats, Graubünden dried beef (Bündnerfleisch), artisan cheeses, and fresh bread with herbal tea or local wine.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange a private luxury transfer (Mercedes V-Class or similar) from the airport to Poschiavo. The drive through the Bernina Pass area is stunning even at night in winter. Confirm late check-in with the B&B in advance. Keep luggage light for easy access — ski gear can be rented locally the next morning.

day_by_day.morning: Leisurely breakfast at the B&B with panoramic Alpine views. After breakfast, take a scenic ride on the UNESCO-listed Bernina Express railway from Poschiavo toward St. Moritz — one of the most breathtaking mountain rail journeys in the world. Arrive in St. Moritz and arrange ski equipment rental at a premium ski shop (e.g., Steff Sport or Ski Service Corviglia) with top-of-the-line Völkl or Rossignol gear fitting.
day_by_day.afternoon: Hit the slopes of Corviglia — St. Moritz's premier ski area accessible via the Chantarella funicular. Enjoy 350km of immaculately groomed pistes with stunning Engadin valley views. Opt for a private ski instructor through the Swiss Ski School St. Moritz for a personalized afternoon session tailored to your skill level.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Poschiavo via Bernina Express. Freshen up at the B&B before heading out for a refined dinner in the village.

meals.breakfast: Full Alpine breakfast at B&B Berninapass — fresh pastries, local honey, Engadin nut tart, cold cuts, soft-boiled eggs, and freshly brewed coffee with mountain spring water.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Restaurant Mathis Food Affairs on Corviglia mountain — a Michelin-recognized alpine dining experience with panoramic views. Try the truffle risotto or pan-seared lake fish.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Ristorante Suisse in Poschiavo — a charming local gem offering Italian-Swiss cuisine. Try the house-made pasta with local truffle and a bottle of Valtellina Superiore red wine.

day_by_day.notes: The Bernina Express from Poschiavo to St. Moritz takes approximately 1 hour. Book first-class panoramic seats in advance. St. Moritz is the closest major luxury ski resort to your accommodation. Private ski lessons should be booked 24–48 hours in advance through the Swiss Ski School.

day_by_day.morning: Early breakfast at the B&B, then depart by private transfer or train toward Zermatt for the full-day Zermatt Ski Safari experience. The journey from Poschiavo to Zermatt takes approximately 3–3.5 hours via train (change at Chur or St. Moritz). Arrive in Zermatt — a car-free village — and check in your gear at a premium ski locker service.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on the Zermatt Ski Safari — explore over 360km of legendary groomed pistes beneath the iconic Matterhorn. With a private mountain guide, ski across the Klein Matterhorn glacier at 3,883m, traverse the Italian border into Cervinia, and experience world-class runs like Weisse Perle and National. The guide will tailor the safari to your ability and pace.
day_by_day.evening: Wind down in Zermatt village. Stroll the charming pedestrian lanes, browse luxury boutiques, and enjoy the magical atmosphere of this iconic Alpine town before the return journey or overnight stay.

meals.breakfast: Full Alpine breakfast at the B&B before departure.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Chez Vrony on the Findeln slope — one of Zermatt's most celebrated mountain restaurants. Enjoy raclette, rösti, or a gourmet burger with Matterhorn views. Reservation essential.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Restaurant Zum See in Zermatt — a legendary rustic mountain restaurant accessible only by ski or foot, offering a 5-course seasonal menu with exceptional Swiss wines. One of the most exclusive dining experiences in the Alps. Reservation required well in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Given the long travel day, consider booking a luxury overnight stay in Zermatt (e.g., The Omnia or Mont Cervin Palace) to maximize time on the slopes and avoid a late return. If returning same day, arrange a private transfer back to Poschiavo. The Zermatt Ski Safari should be pre-booked through Zermatt's official mountain guide service.

day_by_day.morning: Rest morning at the B&B — sleep in and enjoy a slow, indulgent breakfast. Take a gentle morning walk through the historic village of Poschiavo, exploring the Piazza Comunale, the Spanish Quarter, and the Reformed Church. The village has a unique Italian-Swiss character that is charming in winter.
day_by_day.afternoon: Jungfraujoch Top of Europe Tour — depart by train from Poschiavo toward Interlaken (approximately 3.5–4 hours via Chur and Bern). Board the cogwheel train from Grindelwald or Lauterbrunnen up to Jungfraujoch at 3,454m — the highest railway station in Europe. Explore the Ice Palace, walk on the Aletsch Glacier, visit the Sphinx Observatory, and take in 360-degree views of the Bernese Alps. A truly once-in-a-lifetime Alpine experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return journey toward Poschiavo. Given the long travel day, enjoy a relaxed dinner in the village or at the B&B.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely full breakfast at the B&B — eggs Benedict, fresh fruit platter, artisan pastries, and specialty coffee.
meals.lunch: Lunch at the Crystal Restaurant at Jungfraujoch (3,454m) — enjoy hot Alpine soup, fondue, or a warm main course at the top of Europe with extraordinary glacier views.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Albergo Ristorante Croce Federale in Poschiavo — a historic local restaurant offering hearty Graubünden specialties including Capuns (chard-wrapped dumplings), venison ragù, and local Poschiavo wines.

day_by_day.notes: The Jungfraujoch tour is a full-day commitment. Book first-class train tickets well in advance as this is one of Switzerland's most popular attractions. Dress in warm, windproof layers — temperatures at the summit can reach -15°C or lower in February. The Swiss Travel Pass covers most of the journey with a discounted summit ticket.

day_by_day.morning: Depart early by private transfer or train toward Verbier for the Verbier Freeride Experience. The journey from Poschiavo to Verbier takes approximately 4 hours via train (Poschiavo → Chur → Visp → Le Châble, then gondola to Verbier). Arrive and meet your certified IFMGA mountain guide for a briefing and safety equipment fitting (avalanche transceiver, probe, and shovel provided).
day_by_day.afternoon: Guided off-piste freeride session in Verbier — one of the world's top freeride destinations and home of the Freeride World Tour. Your expert guide will lead you through untracked powder fields, couloirs, and backcountry terrain on Mont Gelé or the legendary Vallon d'Arbi, tailored to your experience level. This is an exhilarating, bucket-list Alpine experience.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate an incredible day on the mountain with après-ski in Verbier's legendary scene before returning to Poschiavo or staying overnight.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the B&B before departure — energy-rich options including porridge, eggs, smoked salmon, and fresh juice.
meals.lunch: Lunch at La Vache restaurant in Verbier — a beloved mountain institution known for its exceptional burgers, tartiflette, and lively atmosphere. A Verbier institution.
meals.dinner: Dinner at Le Carrefour in Verbier — a sophisticated restaurant offering refined Alpine cuisine with an extensive wine cellar. Try the beef tenderloin with truffle jus or the pan-seared Arctic char. Alternatively, if returning to Poschiavo, dine at Ristorante Suisse for a relaxed Italian-Swiss evening meal.

day_by_day.notes: The Verbier Freeride Experience requires intermediate to advanced skiing ability. Confirm your skill level with the guide service when booking. An overnight stay in Verbier is highly recommended given the travel distance — consider W Verbier or Hotel Nevai for a luxury experience. Avalanche safety briefing is mandatory and included in the experience.

day_by_day.morning: Return to Poschiavo in the morning if you stayed overnight in Verbier. Alternatively, enjoy a relaxed morning back at the B&B. After settling in, head to the Livigno ski area (just across the Italian border, approximately 45 minutes from Poschiavo by car or shuttle). Livigno offers 115km of varied pistes and is a duty-free zone — perfect for a more relaxed ski day closer to home base.
day_by_day.afternoon: Davos Cross-Country Skiing & Nordic Trail experience — take the train from Poschiavo toward Davos (approximately 2 hours via Filisur). Glide through 100km of perfectly groomed Nordic trails around Davos, the highest city in Europe. Choose from classic or skate skiing styles with equipment rental available at the Davos Nordic Center. The trails wind through pristine snow-covered forests and open Alpine meadows.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Poschiavo for a final evening in the village. Enjoy a celebratory Swiss Alpine Fondue Evening — the perfect way to cap off a week of incredible Alpine adventures.

meals.breakfast: Full breakfast at the B&B — smoked trout, soft cheeses, fresh bread, Alpine honey, and hot chocolate.
meals.lunch: Lunch at Bergrestaurant Jakobshorn in Davos — a cozy mountain restaurant with stunning views. Try the Bündner Gerstensuppe (barley soup) and a warm Schnitzel with rösti.
meals.dinner: Swiss Alpine Fondue Evening at a traditional mountain chalet restaurant in or near Poschiavo — enjoy a classic Gruyère and Vacherin cheese fondue with crusty bread, cornichons, and pearl onions, paired with a crisp Swiss Fendant white wine or warm Glühwein. Arrange this through the B&B for a private or semi-private fondue experience.

day_by_day.notes: The Davos Nordic trails are best experienced in the morning when snow conditions are freshest. Davos also offers the option to visit the famous Schatzalp toboggan run — the longest natural toboggan run in the Alps — for an exciting afternoon addition. Book the fondue evening in advance to secure a private chalet setting.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning in the Swiss Alps — wake up early for one last sunrise over the Bernina massif from the B&B terrace. Enjoy a long, indulgent farewell breakfast. Take a peaceful snowshoe walk through the Poschiavo valley — the B&B can arrange rental snowshoes and a simple trail map for a 1–2 hour self-guided walk through the snow-covered landscape.
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack and check out of the B&B. Depart via private luxury transfer or the Bernina Express toward your departure airport (Zurich approximately 3.5 hours, Milan Malpensa approximately 2.5 hours). The Bernina Express journey itself is a magnificent final memory — passing over the iconic Landwasser Viaduct and through the UNESCO World Heritage Albula/Bernina landscape.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Switzerland. Reflect on an extraordinary week of world-class skiing, breathtaking Alpine scenery, and unforgettable Swiss hospitality.

meals.breakfast: Grand farewell breakfast at the B&B — a full spread of local specialties including Engadin nut tart, Bündnerfleisch, fresh pastries, poached eggs, artisan cheeses, and a celebratory glass of Prosecco.
meals.lunch: Lunch at the historic Bahnhofbuffet restaurant in Chur (if transiting) — a beautifully restored railway dining hall offering refined Swiss cuisine. Try the veal Zurich-style (Zürcher Geschnetzeltes) with Rösti.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight — if departing from Zurich, enjoy a final meal at the Clouds restaurant in the Prime Tower or at the airport's Marché Mövenpick for quality Swiss fare before your flight.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your departure transfer 24 hours in advance. The Bernina Express requires advance seat reservations — book panoramic first-class seats for the best views on your final journey. Allow extra time at the airport for ski equipment check-in if you purchased or rented gear to take home. Consider purchasing local souvenirs in Poschiavo — local honey, Bündner Nusstorte, and Poschiavo wine make excellent gifts.
